verdict.rationale: Restate ships an official, documented CLI for managing services, deployments and invocations (restate-docs-43), which also exposes invocation and application-state introspection (restate-docs-10), and the installation docs cover it (restate-docs-43 reference page, restate-probe-4). missing for 10: evidence of AI-native CLI ergonomics (e.g. machine-readable output or agent-oriented commands), in-depth command documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
